core_principles: Slick and sharp design with black, indigo, and violet trims
High visual hierarchy focusing on the recording and mixing experience
Responsive grids, mobile-first, clear navigation hierarchy

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Control Room Grid for mixers, Tetris Grid for libraries.
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for action buttons, sharp edges for inner elements.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 to define surfaces against the dark background.

components_strategy.navigation: Bottom tab bar for mobile with glassmorphic background, Top header with glassmorphism for settings/profile.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTA (Record/Recognize) is a massive rounded-full button with layered neon drop-shadows. Secondary buttons have 1px solid borders with subtle hover lifts.
components_strategy.stem_mixer: Vertical sliders utilizing Shadcn Slider primitive, custom-colored tracks mapped to stem colors (Cyan, Violet, Red, Yellow). Circular mute/solo toggles.
components_strategy.split_screen: Flex container splitting view equally. Left: Guitar chords (large font, primary colored chords). Right: Lyrics (scrolling, active line highlighted).
components_strategy.waveform_editor: Interactive visualizer/waveform with draggable trim handles (left and right), custom SVGs or recharts.
components_strategy.video_player: Takes up upper half of screen or full background (with overlay), ensuring camera feed is visible while recording.

images.description: Aura music app logo. Sharp geometric abstract soundwave.
Abstract deep space or dark studio background with neon violet soundwaves.
High-end vintage microphone illuminated by moody neon violet and cyan lights.
Person playing electric guitar in dark studio - to be used as placeholder for the camera video feed.

media.icons_library: lucide-react for standard UI (play, pause, mic, video, share, trim, settings). Use react-icons (FaGuitar, FaDrum, FaMicrophone) for specific instrument icons if needed.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Buttons use `-translate-y-1` and intense box-shadow glows on hover.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Smooth transitions on all interactive elements: `transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out`.
interactions_and_motion.visualizer: Pulsing animations for recognizing songs. Scrolling animations for lyrics and chords.
interactions_and_motion.accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast on focus states.

attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

views_breakdown.home: Center big 'Tap to Recognize' button with animated radar rings.
views_breakdown.player_studio: Top: Camera feed / Abstract bg. Middle: Stem Mixer (4 vertical sliders). Bottom: Split-screen (Chords | Lyrics). Floating Action Button: Record.
views_breakdown.edit_share: Waveform view. Trim handles. Social media share buttons.
